senses.gloss:
Bhaje-ratha is mentioned in one passage of the Rigveda, where Ludwig thinks a place-name is meant. Griffith is doubtful whether the word is the name of a place or a man. Roth was inclined to see a corruption of the text. Cf. Bhagīratha.
Foot notes x. 60, 2.
Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 138, 165.
Hymns of the Rigveda, 2, 463.
St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
Grassmann, Wo7rterbuch, s.v., thinks that the compound should be read as two words: bhaje rathasya (satpatim), ‘to win (the lord) of the car.’
